author: Matt Weinberger
title: Apple says some iPhone 8 devices have a manufacturing defect and will fix them for free - here's how to see if you're affected (AAPL)
text: Apple says some iPhone 8 devices have a manufacturing defect and will fix them for free — here's how to see if you're affected (AAPL) By Matt Weinberger Aug 31, 2018, 6:42 pm 31 pts Apple says that a small percentage of iPhone 8 devices might be affected by a "manufacturing defect" that can cause random freezing and other problems. You can check if your phone is affected here. Apple is offering free repairs, but you have to mail away your phone. Apple disclosed on Friday…
